definitions.explanation: An action or plan taken in advance to prevent something undesirable from happening, such as disease, accidents, or problems.

examples.japanese: {予防策|よぼうさく}を{講|こう}じる。
{感染症|かんせんしょう}の{予防策|よぼうさく}として{手洗|てあら}いが{重要|じゅうよう}だ。
examples.english: Hand washing is important as a preventive measure against infectious diseases.

examples.japanese: {災害|さいがい}が{起|お}きる{前|まえ}に、しっかりと{予防策|よぼうさく}を{立|た}てておくべきだ。
examples.english: You should establish thorough preventive measures before a disaster strikes.

notes: Common collocations: {予防策|よぼうさく}を{講|こう}じる (to take/implement preventive measures), {予防策|よぼうさく}を{立|た}てる (to establish preventive measures). The suffix ～{策|さく} (measure, plan) appears in many compound nouns: {対策|たいさく} (countermeasure), {解決策|かいけつさく} (solution), {改善策|かいぜんさく} (improvement measure). Related: {予防|よぼう} (prevention), {対策|たいさく} (countermeasure — reactive rather than preventive).
